title: Prospect Signal Synthesis and Deployment Readiness Canvas
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a repeatable canvas and lightweight scoring process that converts commercial prospect signals (RFPs, POCs, SLA asks, latency/cost constraints) into a prioritized model provisioning and readiness plan. The goal is to reduce time-to-proposal for enterprise prospects by providing an evidence-backed model recommendation, deployment configuration, and estimated cost/latency tradeoffs.
background: Sales and Solutions teams increasingly ask for fast, prescriptive answers about which models and deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private) meet a prospect's constraints. Current analysis is ad-hoc and duplicates effort across PM and SE. We need a standardized synthesize->score->recommend flow that is defensible to procurement and technical stakeholders.
objectives: Design a 6-field prospect canvas that captures: workload profile, latency SLOs, cost sensitivity, data residency/compliance, model behavior risk (hallucination/safety), and integration complexity.
Define a lightweight readiness score (0-100) that maps canvas inputs to deployment recommendations (hosted / dedicated / private) and required engineering tasks.
Prototype a one-page deliverable template (Confluence + slide) and a short internal runbook for Solutions/AE usage.
Instrument a telemetry checklist so PM/Eng can quickly validate whether a recommended model is production-ready for the prospect's workload.
Pilot with two live enterprise prospects and iterate on scoring weights based on feedback.
Surface required capacity and procurement triggers for Dedicated commitments when readiness indicates reserved GPU is necessary.
success_metrics: Reduce average time from prospect ask to internal recommendation from 3 business days to <8 business hours.
Achieve >=80% adoption of the canvas by Solutions/AE for eligible enterprise RFPs within 6 weeks of release.
Pilot feedback Net Promoter Score >=7 from 2 pilot customers on clarity of recommendations.
Measure accuracy: within 10% of predicted latency/cost for 70% of pilot workload samples.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas template published in Confluence with fillable fields and example filled case(s).
Readiness score algorithm documented (weights and rationale) and validated against 3 historical closed deals.
One internal training session completed with Solutions and Sales; at least 5 use attempts logged during pilot.
Checklist items mapped to actionable Eng/Infra tasks and handoff tickets created for deployments requiring Dedicated or Private pathways.
tasks: Interview 6 Solutions engineers and 3 AEs to capture current heuristics and information gaps.
Analyze 10 recent RFPs/POCs to extract common constraints and feature asks.
Draft the 6-field canvas and iterate with PM/SE/Legal for compliance wording.
Define scoring rubric and run against 3 closed deals to calibrate weights.
Create Confluence template + slide export and a short decision-tree cheat sheet.
Coordinate with Eng to map readiness checklist to ticket templates (ENG handoff).
Run two live pilot assessments with assigned Solutions contacts and capture results.
Synthesize pilot learnings and publish v1.0 of the playbook.
notes: 2026-02-20: Initial interviews completed; recurring theme: customers conflate model hallucination risk with latency requirements — canvas should separate behavior risk from performance constraints.
2026-02-28: Draft canvas v0.1 posted to Confluence; requested Legal to review compliance/residency phrasing.
2026-03-05: Scoring prototype tested against three closed deals; predicted deployment mode matched historical choice in 2/3 cases, missed on a cost-sensitive SMB case.
Next: schedule pilot assessments for Prospect A (finserv, strict residency) and Prospect B (SaaS, aggressive latency).
